domain: Zero-Trust Marketplace Security, Sandbox Auditing & Secret Scrubbing

heuristics.name: Zero Leaked Secrets in Uploaded Workflows
heuristics.rule: Every uploaded n8n or Make JSON must be scanned with entropy and regex checkers for OpenAI keys (sk-), Anthropic keys, AWS credentials, and Stripe secret tokens. If detected, reject or auto-scrub with env placeholder (e.g. {{OPENAI_API_KEY}}).
heuristics.impact: Protects community creators from accidental catastrophic credential theft.

heuristics.name: SSRF & Internal Subnet Airgap
heuristics.rule: All HTTP request nodes inside workflows must be verified against private IP ranges (127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.0.0/16, 169.254.169.254) to block Server-Side Request Forgery.
heuristics.impact: Prevents malicious users from deploying exploit workflows.

heuristics.name: HMAC Signed Download Token Gate
heuristics.rule: Digital goods download endpoints must require cryptographically signed HMAC-SHA256 tokens expiring in 24 hours, restricted to 5 downloads per transaction.
heuristics.impact: Eliminates unpaid piracy and hotlinking of digital assets.
